title: Body
description: A rigid body (link) in a mechanism.

kind.description: Self-describing discriminator; always "body" for a Body.

name.description: A human-readable name for this body.

mass.description: This body's mass. Optional; not required for a purely kinematic definition.

inertia.description: This body's rotational inertia tensor about its own frame. Optional; not required for a purely kinematic definition.

visual.description: Application-defined visual representation data for this body (e.g. a mesh reference).

collision.description: Application-defined collision-geometry data for this body.

metadata.description: Opaque, application-defined data carried alongside this body.
